vector.n: No native vector search over data or metadata confirmed.

bulkMetadata.n: CSV import app, Google Sheets or Excel sync, and Python SDK batch save in one API call.

queryHistory.n: Context Agents read query history and lineage; SQL Intelligence turns past queries into evals. Status is Private Preview or unclear.

vendors.nl2sqlPath: Use Atlan as the metadata and context source. Serve it to your own SQL agent over the Atlan MCP server. Keep metrics and joins in a warehouse or semantic layer tool.

snippet.title: Atlan MCP: Claude Desktop uses a local bridge (needs Node.js 18+)
snippet.code:
# No semantic-model syntax. Atlan MCP reads and updates metadata.
# Updatable per agent toolkit: user descriptions, certificate status,
# README, glossary term assignments.
# See the linked setup page for the current client config.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Batch updates with the Python SDK: build stubs with updater() and send the list to client.asset.save in one call. For people-led edits, use the CSV import app or Google Sheets sync. Description attribute name was not confirmed here.

bulkSnippet.code:
# Pattern from Atlan docs: one API call for many assets
assets = []
for q, n in rows:
    a = Table.updater(qualified_name=q, name=n)
    # set attributes to change here (docs example sets certificate status)
    assets.append(a)
client.asset.save(assets)

sources.t: Batch: update multiple assets at once

snippet.title: Run the DataHub MCP server with writes enabled (names from the repo page)
snippet.code:
export TOOLS_IS_MUTATION_ENABLED=true
# plus your GMS URL and token variables per the README
uvx mcp-server-datahub
# Mutation tools include update_description (update, append, remove)

vendors.enrichHowTo: On Cloud, click Generate on a table or column; admins can add custom instructions under Settings > AI. For scripted writes, enable the MCP mutation tools and call update_description. Status of AI generation is unverified.

bulkSnippet.code:
# Mutation tools are off by default
export TOOLS_IS_MUTATION_ENABLED=true
uvx mcp-server-datahub
# then call the update_description tool from your MCP client

snippet.title: List MCP tools (JSON-RPC at POST {OMURL}/mcp, bearer JWT)

vendors.enrichHowTo: On Collate, run the Documentation Agent and approve its suggestions. On open source, call the MCP patch_entity tool to update descriptions, tags and owners. Glossary terms can be bulk loaded by CSV import.

bulkSnippet.code:
# Authorization: Bearer <bot JWT from Settings > Bots>
curl -X POST "$OMURL/mcp" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $JWT" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
# patch_entity updates description, tags, owners (arguments not verified)
